verdict.rationale: The API is inherently natural-language driven (you submit NL queries and get grounded answers), and Perplexity extends this to agentic workflows via a documented MCP server (remote/local), a CLI for shell/agent pipelines, and an Agent API with tool-calling, all confirmed by docs and probes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and community confirmation that NL-command control works smoothly in practice.
